items.quote: we expect trial production to commence in quarter 4 of FY '27, with commercial production to start by quarter 1 of FY '28
items.statement: Asset-light mobile contract manufacturing: trial production in Q4FY27, commercial production by Q1FY28
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

items.quote: we expect to begin with around 8 million units in year 1
items.statement: About 8 million units in year 1 of operations
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

items.quote: we expect to touch the volumes of around 13 million to 15 million in second year of operations
items.statement: Volume of about 13-15 million units in year 2 of operations
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

items.quote: we are taking a conservative number of about 14 million to 15 million number
items.statement: Conservative long-run volume of 14-15 million units by FY29-FY30
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

items.quote: we can take this local value addition to 35% to 40% in the next 5 to 6 years
items.statement: Local value addition of 35-40% in the next 5-6 years
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

items.quote: It will be below INR50 crores to start with.
items.statement: Initial assembly and SMT capex below INR 50 crore
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

items.quote: the ROCEs will be more than 30%, 35%
items.statement: Standalone ROCE of more than 30-35% on the new low-margin business
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

tone.label: confident
tone.why: Management sets concrete volume, timing and capex targets for the new mobile business and calls the capex very minimal, while saying it will go slow and take baby steps.
